description:
Built the old-fashioned way with premium solid hardwoods, the Bloomington Convertible Crib delivers classic warmth and everyday practicality. It transforms effortlessly from crib to toddler bed, daybed, and full-size bed so your child’s sleep space evolves without ever losing that cozy, familiar feel.

Safe, sturdy, and finished in the wood tone you love, it’s the kind of furniture that turns a nursery into a room your family will remember. Picture it as the heart of the nursery: a safe place for newborn sleep that can become a toddler bed, a daybed, and later a full-size bed with the matching conversion pieces. Built for real family life, it is meant to last through years of memories.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
